_comment: Pre-registered decision constants for A/B design 3 (final whole-document gate). Written once from plan sections 2-3 and owner decisions D1-D6; read by harness.py analyze. No threshold literal lives in code.
_comment_min_completed: Fewer completed Sonnet runs than this makes the result INCONCLUSIVE (plan 3, F; 3c).

tokens._comment: D2: loop-only A decides; B = loop + one audit is reported only. Message ids counted once.

baseline_defaults._comment: Stage 2 arm 3 (a3-r1..r6), one audit each. Replaced by the pooled 12-audit values when baseline-audit2 reports exist.

rules._comment: Order of evaluation: DROP-1, DROP-2, DROP-3, ADOPT, else INCONCLUSIVE. Fractions are [numerator, denominator] and are compared by cross-multiplication; they reproduce the plan's counts (n=6: 10/12, 4/6, 8/12; n=9: 15/18, 6/9, 12/18).

DROP3_r_loop_max.formula: R_LOOP_limit = (L * 169468 - 69044) / 100424, rounded to 2 decimals (owner decision D6)
DROP3_r_loop_max._comment: The plan's DROP-3 limit 1.8 was stated against loop+audit (R_B). D6 converts it to a loop-only limit on R_LOOP. Cost is judged post-hoc only; it never stops a run.

haiku_condition._comment: 3b: ADOPT additionally requires 1 - HR > 0 and a Haiku harness-failure rate at most this much above the Haiku baseline's (one run in four).

extension._comment: 3c / D4: once, only after a Sonnet n=6 outcome INCONCLUSIVE (after the replica-agreement check, before the Haiku condition); never a second time.

cost_policy._comment: D6: no loop, replicate, wave or experiment is ever stopped, aborted, truncated or skipped because of token or dollar cost. Cost is evaluated only after runs complete (post-hoc clause DROP-3). Review-count caps (5 reviews, 3 fix cycles), the scoped cap and the stall rule are not cost rules.
